brief: The canvas displays a vast, dynamically evolving lattice of interconnected, glowing cells. The shapes constantly shift, with the patterns organizing and reforming across the space. The background itself pulses rhythmically, darkening and brightening in large cycles. When a cell dies or a new cell emerges, it does not simply vanish; it flashes brightly or leaves behind a visible, ethereal trail of glowing residue that slowly dissipates over several cycles, making the entire field feel constantly active and subtly shifting, independent of any user input.

statement: This sketch creates a dynamic, evolving lattice of glowing cells that pulse and shift across the canvas. Each cell moves independently with its own speed and direction, leaving behind ethereal trails that gradually dissipate. The system uses spatial hashing to efficiently manage connections between nearby cells, creating a constantly shifting web of glowing lines that organically reorganizes itself. The background pulses rhythmically in the dark, amplifying the sense of life and motion within the field, while the entire composition evolves without any user input, creating an immersive, self-sustaining visual ecosystem.
